displayDescription: A terracotta idea rises from a hazy dawn lake and grows ink connections to sage nodes, each confirmed by a ripple ring.
styleRenderer: Three.js WebGL with custom painterly ShaderMaterials (fallback for Blender/EEVEE, which could not start in this sandbox)
Seeded Canvas 2D brush texture, generated once
motionEngine: Deterministic keyframe functions in src/scene.js evaluated from composition time
GSAP paused timeline (master clock and DOM copy only)
limitations: Blender, bpy and EEVEE/Cycles were the reviewed renderers but could not be used: Blender 5.2.2 crashes during the Metal GPU check (MTLBackend::metal_is_supported) inside the sandbox, even in background mode. The scene is a Three.js WebGL equivalent.
Painterly look is approximated with stylized shaders: three-band toon shading, a seeded brush texture triplanar-mapped and locked to the surfaces, faceted normals and no specular highlights.
Cast shadows are analytic projections onto the water plane (soft ellipses and capsules), not shadow maps; there are no shadows on the shore or ridges.
There are no water reflections. Haze is an exponential distance fog, not volumetric.
Text is set in the system Georgia font as HTML over the WebGL canvas.
No rendering or browser QA was run by the agent.
